lines.en: My four feet press the cavern floor.
My frill is heavy.
The ground shakes as I walk.
I walk slowly through the cave.
My tail club drags behind.
I go around those stalagmites.
I chew grass with my head down.

lines.zh: 我朝洞口的亮处踱过去
lines.en: I pace toward the light at the cave mouth
I plant each step without hurry
My horn scrapes the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎了一块石头
lines.en: I crushed a stone underfoot.
I follow the underground stream.
Half-lidded, I chew my cud

lines.zh: 我的头盾挡住了一半视线
lines.en: My frill blocks half my view.
I feel safe in this cave.

lines.zh: 白气从我鼻孔里慢慢喷出
lines.en: White breath drifts slowly from my nostrils
My wounds are slowly healing.
I rub against a stone pillar.
I look up at the cavern roof.
My tail swings now and then.
The dark does not trouble me at all.
I chew a thick stalk.
White breath puffs from my nostrils.
I shift my weight.
There are no predators here.
I listen to dripping water.
You walked into my cave.
I lift my eyes slowly from the grass
You are shorter than the stalagmites.

lines.zh: 别退，这次我只想看看你
lines.en: Do not back off; this time I only want a look
I sense no hostility on you.
My frill is hard.
Step back; I am turning.
Your sleeve smells of the outside

lines.zh: 一只眼看你，一只看洞口
lines.en: One eye on you, one on the cave mouth
Keep your feet where they are.
I swing my body around to you.
You may touch my frill.

lines.zh: 低吼从我喉咙里滚出来
lines.en: A low growl rolls out of my throat
I shifted to one side.
That hit my frill.
I did not fall.
My tail club drooped.
Turning took me a long while.
I do not cry out.
That one had weight.
The wound is closing up bit by bit
I note that impact.
Are these star-fruit?
I like that smell.
Set it by the stalagmite.
I will amble over.
One bite is all that is.
I do not take what is not mine.
Bring another one over.

lines.zh: 我一口一口磨这颗果子
lines.en: I grind the berry one bite at a time
Stop your hand where it is.
That scent lifts my mood.

lines.zh: 你撞上前腿，自己弹开了
lines.en: You hit my foreleg and bounce off
My stride did not even break.
You were shoved back a step.
This body of mine is very heavy.
My horn did not hurt you, did it
My frill brushed you.
That was not a heavy blow.
Step aside.
We are both sturdy.
Next time, go around by the stalagmite
I am in the middle of eating.
That waits for the season.

lines.zh: 我的头盾不是给谁看的
lines.en: My frill is not for display.
I think about that once a year
I do fine alone.
There are no others of my kind here.
I turn my head away slowly.
Go back to your road.
I just want two more mouthfuls of grass
Do not come and interrupt me.
I dip my head and take it.
It will not fill my mouth.
It rolled under a stalagmite.
I cannot budge it with my snout.
I nudged it with my nose.

lines.zh: 那东西滚进洞穴的暗渠了
lines.en: It rolled into the cave's dark channel
Your hand reaches it easier.
My forelimbs cannot reach.
It is caked in mud.
I will push it to you.
You touched that stone.
I dislike anyone touching the stalagmites.
I turn toward you.
My head is down; that is a warning.
I come on, halting between steps.
Back off now and it stops here
I have your spot marked.
This cave is mine.
I have started running.

lines.zh: 你站得越稳我撞得越狠
lines.en: The firmer you stand, the harder I hit
My charge is heavy.
Leave or brace.
I do not often lose my temper.
Your luck is truly bad.

lines.zh: 我踏在你踩过的石板上
lines.en: I step on the flags you crossed.
You went behind a stalagmite.
I knocked the stalagmite down.
My steps are heavy.
You cannot outrun my four legs.
I turn around very slowly.
You circle, and I circle too.
My tail club sweeps the ground.
Do you hear stone breaking?
This cave has few paths.
I blocked that one.
The only way is deeper.
My head stays lowered.
I am still picking up speed.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停在你面前
lines.en: You stop, and I stop right in front of you
I ram with my frill.
This charge carries my whole bulk.
You are driven backward.
My horn grazed you.
I swung my tail across.
The tail club swept you down.
You did not guard your flank.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推开了三格
lines.en: That pushed you three blocks.
I have not caught my breath after the tail swing
I do not want a second charge.
You can still stand.
My frill aches.
Get behind the pillar.
My lowered head is the last warning.
I come from deep in the cave.
Something moved behind the stalagmites.
My footsteps arrive first.

lines.zh: 这片地下空间很合适我
lines.en: This cavern suits me.
I lift my frill.
I cracked a stone.
I smell grass.
I grew up in this cave.
I walk slowly into the light.
My breath stirs dust.
I did not come looking for trouble.
You heard my steps before you saw me
I halt by a stone pillar.
Only water should sound here.
I tilt my frill toward you
My wounds have healed.
Fire tightens my hide.
I rolled down the stone steps.
The water is too deep for my feet.
The blast drove me back.
An arrow struck my frill.
The spell weighs down my four legs.
There is not enough grass in this cave.
Thunder echoes long in this cave.
There is not a single stone here.
